header: Exclude a rule from correlation using the UI
content:

You can manually add or remove the #DONT_CORR#  tag to control the correlation state of an
analytics rule.
1. Open the analytics rule in edit mode.
2. In the rule's Description field, add #DONT_CORR#  at the very beginning of the text.
3. Save the rule.
You can programmatically control the exclusion state of analytics rules by adding or removing
the #DONT_CORR#  tag through the analytics API.
To modify a rule's correlation state:
1. Use the Microsoft Defender XDR API to retrieve the rule's current configuration.
2. Add or remove the #DONT_CORR#  tag at the beginning of the rule's description field.

